license_proposal.covers: Files whose every origin has permission_status proposed-mit-pending-owner-approval.

permission_statuses.proposed-mit-pending-owner-approval: Written for agent-ee or produced by its runs from such material. MIT is proposed; owner approval is pending.
permission_statuses.unresolved-owner-decision-required: Originates in another project. Not offered under MIT. Publication requires an explicit owner decision recorded here.
permission_statuses.owner-confirmed: Owner decision recorded in owner_record (date, decision and where it was given).
permission_statuses.derived: Captured or generated under an owner-confirmed origin that embeds upstream origins whose permission_status is unresolved; check_origins names each embedded upstream origin id and upstream_license.

kinds.owned-source: Code, tests, scripts and configuration written for agent-ee.
kinds.owned-documentation: Documentation and reports written for agent-ee.
kinds.owned-fixture: Original fixture designs, generators and expectations written for agent-ee.
kinds.owned-metadata: Records written for agent-ee that name or describe third-party material without copying it.
kinds.adapted-source: Code written for agent-ee that contains logic adapted from another project.
kinds.copied-design: Verbatim or modified copies of design files from another project.
kinds.third-party-document: Verbatim copies of documents, pages, firmware sources or text extractions from another party.
kinds.third-party-data: Other data published by another party.
kinds.retained-output: Tool, coordinator and reviewer outputs retained as evidence.
kinds.generated-design-output: Plots, renders, Gerber and drill outputs generated from a design.
kinds.evidence-archive: Compressed evidence bundle holding a readable copy of an evidence directory, its captured inputs and generated run configuration.
kinds.third-party-source: Vendored third-party software with its own license and retained notices.

matching: Each rule path is an exact tracked path, or a directory prefix ending in "/". A rule with suffixes matches only names ending in one of them. The most specific match wins: an exact path, then the longest prefix, then a suffix-filtered rule. Two equally specific matches are an error. A file's permission status is unresolved if any of its declared origins is unresolved, derived if an owner-confirmed origin embeds an unresolved upstream origin (with each embedded origin id and upstream_license named), otherwise owner-confirmed if any of its origins is owner-confirmed, otherwise proposed.
risk_review: scripts/check_origins.py flags files by name (PDF, HTML, images, archives, KiCad design/library files, library tables, Gerber/drill, C/C++, PGP keys) and, for files whose origins are agent-ee only, by content markers (embedded KiCad design text, PDF/HTML headers, PGP blocks, rights notices, donor and third-party project names). A flagged file passes only with a third-party origin or an exact-path rule that records a review.
